notes: One-off run 2026-10-30 (user): healthcare/nurses + travel, specific sub-roles (ER, night shift, travel nurse, CNA, OR, L&D, home health) and trips (Disney incl. plus-size, Rome, cruise, long-haul flights). Research: Atria current winners (14 ads, Oct), wellness pull ranked by 7-day growth (203 kept), Hike/Stepprs rivals pull (259 ads). 11 new formats + 5 proven layouts. Offers 5/16. Rendered with Kie.ai 2K.
